subject.title: fix(gateway): occupied non-gateway ports exit nonzero

question: Should this PR be accepted as the gateway startup contract: exit 0 only for a confirmed healthy unmanaged OpenClaw gateway, and exit nonzero for every unconfirmed occupied port?
rationale: The code and supplied live proof support the proposed behavior, but the protected maintainer label reserves final acceptance of this CLI supervisor-facing exit-status change for human review.

options.title: Accept the verified contract
options.body: Rebase or refresh the clean merge result, then merge if the focused runtime contracts remain green.

options.title: Preserve broader duplicate-start success
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers intend any occupied port with a responding HTTP server to remain a successful no-op, then document and test that alternate contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the verified contract
